Żeli Papą.definition:
Żeli Papą (pronounce in French: jolie poix pont, means: nice brick bridge ). In common use an epithet to describe someone / someone's skills, especially self-proclaimed [francophile], [detached from reality] so far that this person believes in it without a doubt.
Term is derived from Polish subgenre of rap "franswag Je la font" [originated] by Lech Roch Pawlak raper from Nowa Wieś Królewska (Opole, PL).
Żeli Papą.example:
([Polish])
-a ty coś szpącisz, nawijasz?
-rapuję po francusku.
-poka, poka!
-jolie poix pont, [phase] a mic tonem a se [la Vie]. Shuka me te télé pack a Vie a saviez..
-LOLOLOLOL jprdl, toż to żeli papą obok francuskiego nigdy nie stało!

żydy.definition:
[Pronounced] zhydy, an [offensive] polish word meaning Jews, though it can be used as a [replacement] word for “ouch” in any language.

Can also be used when you mess something up, then you shout it out!
żydy.example:
*stubs toe*

-ŻYDYYYY! ŻYDY ŻYDY ŻYDYYYY!

-Chill out bro, can’t [listen] to you [screamin] [no more]..

Żbubies.definition:
Maltese word for someone who has tits in the form of żbub (dicks).

It is said [that the] god of the Żbubist [religion] suffered from this [phenomenon].

"Aw liba rajtu lil [Trisman] kemm [ghandu] żbubies sbieħ?"
